chapter.verse: Thubul hoih khat tawh keima lungsim hong dimlet-in, ka late kumpipa tungah ka sak a, ka leii in lai theipa’ laikung tawh kibang hi.
Mihing’ tate lakah nangmah na hoihpen a, thugen siamin na kam khum zungzung hi; tua ahih ciangin Pasian in nang thupha hong pia tawntung hi.
Vanglianpa aw, na minthan’na leh na liatna tawh, na namsau kuah in.
Thumanna a om nading leh thuman hu’ dingin na minliatna tawh gualzo-in hong pusuak in la, dipkuat-huai hih nate na taklam khut nangmah kihilhsak in!
Kumpipa’ galte’ lungtang sungah na thaltang hiamte lut a, mite na nuai-ah puk uh hi.
Na kumpi tokhom siangtho kip tawntung hi. Na kumpi ciangkhut in thumanna ciangkhut hi a,
thumanna deihin gitlohna na mudah hi. Tua ahih ciangin Pasian ahi, nangma Pasian in, na gualpihte tungah kikhaito-in lungdamna sathau tawh nang hong nilh zo a,
na puantualpi mirrah paknamtui, alo paknamtui leh thalsing namtuite a nam hi. Saiha tawh kibawl innpite panin khausai lasaknate in nang hong lungdamsak-in,
kumpite tanute, numei uliante lakah om a, na taklam ah Ofir gam khamte tawh kizemin kumpinu a ding hi.
Tanu aw, ngai in, ngaihsun in la, na bil hong ngat in; nangma mite leh na behte mangngilh in;
kumpipa in na mel hoihna deih ding hi. Na topa ahih ciangin ama mai-ah kun in;
mihau pente ahi Tai-ar mite in na manpha namkim letsong tawh nang hong maivil ding uh hi. Kumpi tanu a inndei sungah kham kigan puantualpi tawh kizem a,
mel tuamtuam a nei puantualpite silhin mihon kigual deudaute lakah a kithuahpih nungakte leh amah a khate tawh kumpipa kiangah kipaipih hi.
Kumpipa innah a tun’ ciangun lungdamna leh nuamna tawh amaute kitumpih hi.
Na pate’ tang dingin na tapate hi ding a, nangmah in leitung khempeuh ah amaute, ulian na suaksak ding hi.
Keimah in khang tawntungin nangma min ka kiphawksak ding hi; tua ahih ciangin mite in nang hong phat ngitnget ding uh hi.
